We are seeking a Programmer to work with the Pipelines, Distributions, & Terminals (PD&T) Admin Area to develop, implement, and maintain computer-based programs, systems, and procedures. The successful candidate will utilize their skills in programming, and software coding techniques to create, revise, and enhance business systems application programs.

Responsibilities
• Design, code, test, and debug new programs or modify existing applications to meet operational and user needs.
• Integrate AI/ML models and trending technologies into backend/frontend systems for production deployment.
• Develop system logic, flowcharts, and comprehensive documentation, including user manuals and technical guides.
• Create test data and simulate procedures to validate code functionality across different languages and environments.
• Perform other related technical duties as assigned by the supervisor to support system stability and improvements.

Qualifications
• At least 3-5 years of experience in programming, software development, and system analysis is preferred.
• Strong knowledge of programming languages, including ASP.Net, C#, Python, and others.
• Experience with database servers, SQL language, and handling large datasets.
• Experience in software engineering and algorithm structures.
• Ability to read, analyze, & debug programming codes in the above-mentioned languages, including ML libraries.
• Experience with backend/frontend skills, cloud services, API integration, and integrating AI/ML models into production environments.
• Experience in integrating codes, as well as running and compiling integrated scripts from different languages and models.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Python, and web services at scale. We are building the next generation management solution for Ubuntu in the enterprise - on premise and on the public cloud - to enable large estate observability, telemetry, security, compliance and operations. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Landscape is the leading management tool to deploy, monitor and manage fleets of Ubuntu systems, including package and repository management, health and security monitoring, hardware inventory, and automation. As Landscape software engineer you will be responsible for contributing on a distributed development team participating in all facets of the development process.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

What you'll do

• Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
• Write high-quality code to create new features, fix bugs and modernize the Landscape codebase
• Demonstrate your strong commitment to code quality and automated testing
• Participate in the engineering process with code and architectural reviews
• Take personal ownership of problems and design and deliver solutions
• Work remotely with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
• Assist with release management during each development cycle
• Collaborate with devops for Landscape SaaS, Canonical's hosted Landscape

Who you are

• You love technology and working with brilliant people
• You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
• You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
• You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
• You have proficiency developing public-facing APIs and web applications, preferably using Python.
• Experience with Python and web frameworks such as Flask and Django.
• Experience with databases, and ORMs (PostgreSQL a plus)
• You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

We’re building the complete data stack for AI — exascale object store, table store, agent memory, and brain: every layer of how AI stores, retrieves, and thinks over data. Hard problems with no existing answers. Bring your own.

What You Will Do

You’ll own problems end-to-end — the kind most engineering teams never get close to. No ticket queues, no standups, no permission. Just you, the codebase, and a team of people who care as much as you do. Everyone here is an IC, an architect, or a lead — most are all three.

Your Skills And Experience

Deep OS internals. Networking from the socket layer up. Strong opinions on memory, concurrency, and correctness — and the humility to revise them. You’ve debugged something no one else could reproduce.You’ve read source code not because you had to, but because it was bothering you.

Key Competencies

• Fluent in ≥2 languages, honest about tradeoﬀs
• You debug by understanding, not by guessing
• Grit: you start hard things and finish them
• Curiosity you genuinely can’t switch oﬀ
• Low ego, extremely high standards
• You write code the next engineer respects
• Operating Systems, Networking, Systems Programming, Distributed Systems, Storage Engines, Vector/Graph Retrieval, Low -Latency I/O, and Protocol Design

MinIO Engineering Culture

• All leads, architects and ICs — no managers
• Full ownership from day one, no permission needed
• Decisions made by the people doing the work
• Craftsmanship is a first-class engineering concern
• No sprints. No standups. No Jira.

What We Offer

• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
• 401K with 3% Contribution
• Pre-IPO Stock Options
• At least 12 Public Holidays
• Flexible Time Off

Please include a sample of your work. Examples could include a repo, write up, postmortem, We care more about the work you have done more than a resume. - Submissions without samples will not be considered

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Movandi has made a big impact on 5G in a short amount of time — from foundational research and innovative modular, high efficiency mmWave system design to the introduction of our BeamXR 5G system that delivers improvements in performance, coverage, and latency to connect 5G everywhere. Now more than ever, 5G--supported by Movandi technology--is becoming an integral part of the telecommunications landscape. And we're only getting started.

At Movandi we work as a team. We like hard problems and solving them with the sharpest people. Are you looking to make a difference on the future of technology? At Movandi, you will help solve the growing challenges of deploying 5G millimeter wave networks. You will make an impact.

About The Role

Movandi is looking for a motivated and skilled Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for supporting the Firmware Development Team in the design, development and production of our firmware supported products. You will be responsible for testing, documenting, and creating firmware standards.

Duties And Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware (C/C++).
• Support bring-up of new hardware platforms.
• Debug and optimize embedded software systems.
• Develop and execute firmware test strategies.
• Gathering and analyzing requirements from customers.
• Write and maintain technical documentation (developer and user guides).
• Conduct code reviews and ensure high-quality standards.
• Collaborate with Digital design, RF verification, and DevOps teams.
• Work with customers to investigate and resolve technical issues.

Technical Requirements

• Completed Bachelor of Engineering/Mechatronics/Electrical Engineering or related degree (Master's preferred).
• 6+ years of experience in embedded systems development, testing and deployment.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++.
• Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or testing.
• Experience with automated testing and module unit testing in Python (Pytest, fixtures, etc).
• Strong working knowledge of microcontrollers and Linux-based embedded systems.
• Experience interfacing with common embedded hardware peripherals (flash, eMMC, FPGA, GPIO, sensors, etc).
• Experience developing and interfacing with static/dynamic libraries for various embedded targets and architectures.
• Experience using version control & collaboration tools (Git, Confluence, Jenkins, etc).

Build & Tooling

• Experience with cross-compilation and build systems (Makefiles, CMake, etc).
• Familiarity with compiler toolchains (GCC, Clang).
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).
• Knowledge of reproducible builds, dependency management, and automated testing.

Other Requirements

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Demonstrated working well in a team environment and collaborate with members across geographies.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Strong organizational skills.
• Demonstrated ability to understand and work with electrical schematics.
• Experience with lab tools: (logic analyzer, JTAG debugger, oscilloscope, power supply, signal generator etc).

Nice To Have

• Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical efforts.
• Exposure to wireless communication systems and performance testing.

Citizenship Requirement

• Please note that we can only accept applications from Saudi Arabia citizens.

FileCloud is looking for an enthusiastic Senior PHP Backend Developer to join our team in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As part of the Growth & Expansion team, you will be responsible for developing server-side functionality and building scalable cloud-based services. We are looking for a mid-level or senior developer.  This role is fully office-based and will require working in our office in Riyadh and connecting with the wider, global FileCloud team

About the Product & Company:

FileCloud is a hyper-secure EFSS (enterprise file sync and share) platform that provides industry leading compliance, data governance, data leak protection, data retention and digital rights management capabilities. FileCloud is a leader in content governance and collaboration for unstructured data, trusted and used worldwide across Global 1000 enterprises, educational institutions, government organizations, and service providers. In addition to its enterprise file sharing solution, FileCloud’s product portfolio also includes Signority (acquired in May 2024), a Canadian-based e-signature and document workflow platform. We are currently expanding our team as we grow and improve FileCloud.

Responsibilities:

• Create elegant, efficient and bulletproof software to support and extend our current software products
• Use tools including PHPStorm, MongoDB, NodeJS, AWS/AZURE, GIT, Memcache, Code Reviews, PHPUnit, Solr, among others
• Solve complex architectural challenges when implementing new features
• Integrate with databases, file systems, cloud services when delivering solutions
• Troubleshoot and fix reported customer issues, delivering software patches as needed
• Share your knowledge and experience with other engineers

Qualifications:

• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
• 3+ years of experience in web app development
• 3+ years in PHP development
• Strong knowledge of the following:
• Automation testing
• Client server architecture is required
• Object-oriented programming and design patterns
• PHP ecosystems (PHP 8.2+ experience, Composer, PHPUnit)
• Web technologies including HTTP protocol, XML, REST
• Highly proficient in spoken and written English with strong communication skills
• Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of a daily development workflow - for code generation, review, debugging, and documentation.

Nice-to-Have:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline
• Knowledge of modern PHP frameworks
• Experience in enterprise system’s architecture (Architecture Patterns, Eventing, Queues)
• Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases like MongoDB and their declarative query languages
• Basic understanding of front-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
• Knowledge of CI/CD (Jenkins preferred), Docker, SOLR, Redis
• Experience developing with NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript.

What We Offer – These Do Not Change

• Be part of a team of passionate, committed individuals dedicated to building a world-class product
• Dedicated time for training and education opportunities
• A mentorship model wherein your mentor and team support your development
• A competitive salary with an annual bonus
• Onsite work with flexible hours that fall outside of 9am -12pm (US Eastern Standard Time)
• 20 days of paid time off, which increases by a further 2 days after 3 years of service and 3 days after 5 years of service (in addition to 10 public holidays in your country)
• Paid day off on your birthday or on an alternative day if your birthday falls outside a typical working day
• Paid day off to volunteer with the charity of your choice
• Paid monthly internet cost, as well as lunch and a wellbeing stipend provided
• Reimbursement of all hardware costs associated with the role

Please note that we conduct background security checks for everyone joining our team.

AI-assisted screening may be used during the application review process.

Build Mobile Experiences. Scale Impact. Power Commerce.

At Zid, we’re not just building software, we're building the infrastructure behind retail success in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to empower merchants to start, grow, and scale through a unified, seamless commerce ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer, a product-minded engineer who thrives on building reliable mobile experiences, solving complex technical challenges, and turning product ideas into high-quality features that make a real impact.

Mobile will be your primary focus, with opportunities to contribute to web frontend development when product priorities require it. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to build, ship, and continuously improve Zid’s mobile experiences.

AI-assisted engineering is also a core part of this role. You’ll work with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar coding agents throughout the development lifecycle, while owning the technical decisions and the final result.

What You’ll Do:

1. Mobile Development & Product Engineering
• Build and ship complex mobile features using React Native and Expo across iOS and Android.
• Turn PRDs, designs, and acceptance criteria into scalable technical solutions and production-ready software.
• Own mobile product quality from technical planning through release readiness.
• Build fast, responsive, accessible, and RTL-ready experiences for both Arabic and English users.
• Contribute to web frontend features using React and TypeScript when product priorities require it.

2. Offline, Data & Performance
• Design reliable mobile experiences that remain useful and predictable when connectivity is weak, interrupted, or unavailable.
• Implement local data models, caching, migrations, synchronization, retries, and conflict handling using SQLite, Realm Database, or similar technologies.
• Integrate REST APIs and manage asynchronous data and application state using tools such as Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, or similar solutions.
• Debug and optimize application performance across different devices, operating systems, and network conditions.

3. Quality, Testing & Technical Ownership
• Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Jest, React Testing Library, Detox, or similar tools.
• Own technical decisions around mobile architecture, quality, security, and release readiness.
• Debug complex iOS, Android, network, and device-specific issues.
• Support mobile CI/CD, app releases, monitoring, and store submission processes.
• Identify technical debt and continuously improve the architecture and reliability of the mobile codebase.

4. AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
• Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools as part of your everyday engineering workflow.
• Give coding agents clear context, break work into meaningful steps, and direct them effectively across the codebase.
• Use AI tools for implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, maintenance, and technical documentation.
• Stay current with modern mobile engineering and AI-assisted development practices.

5. Collaboration & Technical Leadership
• Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to shape scope, feasibility, risks, and technical options.
• Lead technical discussions and explain complex engineering concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, code reviews, and written guidance.
• Own high-impact initiatives, unblock teammates, surface risks early, and improve engineering workflows.

Who We’re Looking For:

Experience:
• 3+ years of professional experience building mobile applications.
• Strong production experience with React Native and Expo.
• Proven ability to independently deliver complex mobile features from planning to production.

Skills:
• Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills.
• Strong understanding of mobile architecture, app lifecycle, navigation, performance, and platform constraints.
• Experience with SQLite, Realm Database, or similar local data stores.
• Experience with state management and server data tools such as Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, or similar.
• Experience integrating APIs and handling loading, error, empty, and offline states.
• Experience writing and maintaining automated tests.
• Experience debugging iOS and Android applications and supporting mobile releases.
• Experience with mobile CI/CD.
• Strong understanding of responsive layouts, accessibility, internationalization, and RTL interfaces.
• Active experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools.

Nice to Have:
• Professional experience building web frontends with React, TypeScript, Next.js, or similar frameworks.
• Experience working across both mobile and web frontend codebases.
• Experience with Swift, Kotlin, or native mobile modules.
• Experience with mobile performance, accessibility, observability, or security testing.
• Experience with background tasks, offline-first architecture, or data synchronization.
• Experience with GraphQL or event-driven data flows.
• Experience in e-commerce, point-of-sale, payments, inventory, or other commerce products.
• Contributions to open-source projects or internal tools that improve engineering workflows.
• Experience coaching engineers or leading technical initiatives.

Personal Attributes:
• Strong ownership mindset with a focus on quality and delivery.
• Product-minded with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.
• Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working across teams.
• Adaptable and comfortable moving between mobile and web frontend work when needed.
• Clear communicator who can explain technical decisions and trade-offs effectively.
• Curious and committed to continuous learning in mobile and AI-assisted engineering.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Why Join Zid 🚀
• Purpose-Driven Work: Build mobile experiences that power thousands of merchants and their businesses.
• Technical Impact: Solve complex mobile challenges across offline experiences, performance, data, and scale.
• AI-First Engineering: Work with modern AI coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow.
• Growth & Learning: Work alongside strong engineers and continuously expand your technical and product expertise.
• People & Culture: Join a collaborative, ambitious, and supportive engineering environment.
• Impact: Play a key role in shaping the future of commerce in Saudi Arabia.

Position Summary:

Design, develop and maintain scalable data management platforms, dashboards and backend systems to support a county‑wide environmental monitoring program. The role combines software development, database architecture and systems integration to process, store and visualize multi‑source environmental data reliably and securely.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and implement robust database architectures (relational and spatial) and data models to support environmental monitoring datasets.

• Develop backend services, APIs and ETL pipelines for ingesting, validating and transforming data from multiple sources (field devices, labs, satellite/UAV, third‑party feeds).

• Build interactive dashboards and visualization components for data exploration, reporting and decision support.

• Optimize application and database performance, ensure scalability and high availability.

• Implement data security, access control, backup and recovery procedures; ensure compliance with data confidentiality requirements.

• Apply software engineering best practices: version control, automated testing, CI/CD and documentation.

• Collaborate with GIS specialists, data engineers, statisticians and field teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

• Prepare technical specifications, system architecture diagrams and deployment plans.

• Provide troubleshooting, maintenance and support for production systems; monitor system health and respond to incidents.

• Support knowledge transfer and provide training documentation for client staff.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.

• Strong understanding of database design, data modeling and data warehousing principles.

• Familiarity with spatial data and geodatabases is an advantage.

Experience:

• 3-5 years of professional experience in software development and database architecture.

• Proven experience building data platforms, ETL processes, APIs and dashboards for medium to large datasets.

• Experience integrating diverse data sources and optimizing database performance.

Technical Skills:

• Programming: Python and/or JavaScript;

experience with backend frameworks (e.g., Flask, Django, Node.js).

• Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL/PostGIS preferred), NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) and knowledge of schema design and indexing.

• Data processing: ETL tools, data pipelines, and familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow) beneficial.

• Data visualization: experience with BI tools or libraries (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, D3, Plotly).

• APIs and integration: RESTful API development and experience with JSON, GeoJSON.

• DevOps/Deployment: familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP) and monitoring tools.

• Testing, version control (Git) and automated build/test practices.

Work Location: In person
